consumer_context.important_limitation: rustls-native-certs::load_native_certs first parses explicit environment paths itself with env::split_paths and loads them directly. The platform fallback calls openssl_probe::probe only if no explicit file or directory was selected. Therefore the isolated package defects are not proof that the normal Searchright consumer path broadens caller-configured trust stores.
consumer_context.host_tree_limitation: Host-only cargo tree on macOS did not include openssl-probe; the dependency path was obtained with --all-features --target all.
